title: ING Analytics Senior Business Control Officer
full_description:
As a Senior Business Control Officer you facilitate risk identification, provide oversight of the health of control environment, and drive the execution of the risk management deliverables within the Analytics department in ING. This role is crucial in ensuring the identification, assessment, and mitigation of operational risks across the organization.The ideal candidate will possess sound banking experience either in risk management, consultancy or technology area.Your Day-to-Day:
